observations: Two retail boxes for Sony PlayStation 5 consoles are shown.
The box art depicts the 'Slim' model design, characterized by the horizontal slit in the side panels.
A watermark 'HYMANGADGETS BACK UP POSTED ON JIJI' is visible across the center of the image.
No console, controller, or accessories are visible outside of the packaging.
No factory seals are visible on the box flaps in the provided angle.

claims.evidence: No factory seals are visible to confirm the boxes have never been opened.
photo 0 box art shows the slim model design.
Internal hardware specifications cannot be verified from external packaging photos.

risks.risk: The boxes may be empty or contain a different item.
risks.proof: A photo of the console and controller outside the box with a handwritten note of the current date.

risks.risk: The console may be used or refurbished despite the 'Brand New' claim.
risks.proof: Clear, close-up photos of intact, untampered factory seals on the box openings.

risks.risk: The console may be non-functional or banned from the PlayStation Network.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen and successfully connecting to the internet.

proof_requests: Photo of the console and controller outside the box with a handwritten note of today's date.
Close-up photos of the factory seals on the box flaps.
Photo of the model and serial number label on the console itself.
response.reason: Only the retail packaging is shown, and the photo contains a watermark from a third-party marketplace/dealer. Verification of the actual console's existence and condition is required before a price can be determined.
